text: The figure above is the model as written. `CALL db.schema.visualization()` reports the model the page's database holds once the cells up to `seed` have run: one node per label, one relationship per type and pair of labels, and each label's indexes and constraints. When the page was recorded, those cells wrote 5 nodes and 5 relationships.
